data.one_liner: Adds system tray menu and tray icon support to Flutter desktop apps.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter desktop applications on Windows, macOS, and Linux to display a system tray icon, customize its appearance, manage tooltips, and create native context menus. It also supports registering system tray events like clicks, right-clicks, and double-clicks.
use_when: Building a desktop application in Flutter that needs to run in the background with a system tray icon.
Providing a native context menu or quick actions from the OS tray/menu bar.
avoid_when: Targeting mobile or web platforms exclusively, as this package is for desktop platforms.
Managing complex in-app UI routing or state.
strengths: Provides a rich set of tray features including custom icons, tooltips, titles, checkboxes, and submenus.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific prerequisites on Linux (e.g., installing appindicator libraries).
Some features (like tooltips or titles) have platform limitations and are not supported on all operating systems.
data.setup_notes: On Linux, you need to install appindicator dependencies via apt-get.
